description: This file defines the 'NotesSyncWorker' class, a Worker implementation using Android's WorkManager that performs note synchronization tasks, specifically for syncing notes when network is available. It uses coroutines for asynchronous execution and interacts with the application's repository to trigger synchronization.

classes.name: NotesSyncWorker
classes.description: A worker that performs synchronization of notes in the background, utilizing WorkManager and coroutines. It handles success and retry logic based on the outcome of the sync operation.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the suspend method to perform the syncing operation. Calls the application's repository to sync notes and determines success or trigger a retry based on exceptions.
